comments.author: Theo
comments.body: Sorry but I don't really know. I just gave woad because it was the nearest to acquire and I don't care much about colour :-). I know tyrian purple works too and I suspect either bark or logwood as well. You can get clues by talking to NPCs around Venice. Some band members tell you things about their own costumes. Also, there's a "well-informed man" NPC, I think close to Michelangelo and Paracelsus estates that gives another clue. Also, somewhere between the guilds area and the main square there are two NPCs, a "boy" and a "girl". One of them gives a hint about a colour. Hope that helps.
